Metadata.title: MaillotF — Jerseys & sports equipment
Metadata.description: Custom club jerseys (name/number printing) and sports equipment, sold online.

Home.heroTitle: Your jersey, your name, your number
Home.heroSubtitle: Customizable club jerseys and sports equipment, delivered in Nouakchott. Mobile payment (Bankily, Masrvi, Sedad) or cash on delivery.

Product.numberInvalid: The number must be between 0 and 99.
Product.personalizationNote: Longer preparation time for personalized items — printing starts once payment is confirmed.

Cart.title: Cart
Cart.emptySubtitle: Browse the catalogue to find your jersey.

Checkout.title: Complete your order
Checkout.addressNoteRequired: Required for mobile payment: the order goes into preparation as soon as payment is confirmed.
Checkout.addressNoteOptional: For cash on delivery, we'll call you to confirm the order and get the exact address if needed.

Confirmation.title: Order sent!
Confirmation.body1: Thanks for your order. You can track its status at any time with your phone number.
Confirmation.body2: For cash on delivery, we'll call you back to confirm before preparation starts.

Tracking.title: Track my order
Tracking.subtitle: Enter the phone number used when ordering — no account needed.
Tracking.notFound: No order found for this number yet — real-time tracking will be active once the catalogue and orders are connected to the database (Supabase).

Admin.title: Admin area
Admin.unprotectedWarning: ⚠️ Unprotected page — needs to be secured with Supabase Auth before going live.
Admin.ordersEmpty: No orders yet — the order list (with status filters, status changes, payment view and stats) will be wired up once the Supabase database is connected.
